purpose: Shared node/edge contract for the Current context Graph projection. Graph consumes governed Scope records and reusable Features without creating ownership or authority.
rules: Graph nodes are references to authoritative records, not replacement copies.
Current graph nodes may expose scope_id only when a governed source explicitly provides it; missing Scope is not guessed.
feature_ids are derived from governed content-type/record metadata and describe reusable capabilities, never ownership.
Historical LOC1–8 identifiers may remain only in provenance or compatibility source data and are never Current graph anchors.
Canonical edges require explicit registry evidence, authoritative metadata, or deterministic structural evidence.
Semantic similarity may select seed nodes but must never create a canonical edge by itself.
ERA records form a deterministic temporal backbone from LOC_ERA_REGISTRY.
Search-time result nodes may receive transient belongs_to_era and media/work linkage edges from recorded metadata.
Graph traversal is bounded and feeds Search Synthesis with connected Features, ERA paths, works, media and analysis nodes.
Repository temporal/event snapshots may contribute public observation nodes without replacing their owning Scope authority.
Private source relations are never exposed through public Search unless explicitly governed into a public registry/snapshot.
Search responses expose a provenance envelope summarizing source_refs and graph evidence kinds/status.
Every traversable edge carries edge_quality and quality_band derived from relation type, evidence kind and evidence status.
Traversal priority is quality-weighted and decays by hop; paths below min_traversal_score are not expanded.
belongs_to_era is a directional structural projection and must not be used as a reverse-discovery hub.
Named/historical entity queries may use exclusive canonical seeds; abstract concept queries retain cross-source retrieval breadth.
Public Graph access is metadata-only by default; graph payload requires a bounded center or query-driven Search result.

search_synthesis.seed_source: precision-aware Unified Search results + canonical exact entity matches

provenance.public_relation_policy: Only governed public relation/context snapshots are exposed. Private source rows remain private until explicitly published; Graph does not create Scope ownership.

quality_policy.model: edge_quality = evidence_weight × status_weight × relation_weight; traversal_score = parent_path_score × edge_quality × hop_decay^(hop-1)

rules: GET /search/graph without node_id returns counts/type metadata only and never the canonical node/edge payload.
Actual graph payload is exposed only through bounded neighborhood lookup or query-driven Search Graph results.
Views consume the public bounded projection and do not become canonical graph authority.
Live private relation rows remain outside public Graph unless explicitly governed into a public registry/snapshot.
